gaps.consequence: Callers received status 'executed' even though no task was dispatched, validated, or completed.
gaps.remediation: Replaced with a task engine that dispatches registered adapters, validates results, records evidence, and completes/fails the mission.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Real shell task completes the mission; failure/timeout/cancel paths never report success.
gaps.evidence: packages/orchestrator/tests/orchestrator.test.ts (17 cases), including a real child process.

gaps.consequence: No typed task contract, status, error taxonomy, acceptance criterion, or result schema existed.
gaps.rootCause: Task orchestration was never modeled as a first-class domain.
gaps.remediation: Added TaskStatus, TaskErrorCode, TaskAcceptance, TaskDefinition, TaskError, AdapterResult, TaskResult and TaskEvent schemas.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Malformed adapter results are rejected; task results conform to the schema.
gaps.evidence: Adapter output is parsed with AdapterResultSchema before use; test 'rejects malformed adapter output'.

gaps.consequence: A caller could assert passing evidence without executing anything; no executed-vs-reported distinction.
gaps.remediation: Added provenance (executed/reported/simulated), executionId, verificationMode and EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Executed-mode mission rejects reported and simulated evidence; accepts executed evidence with executionId.

gaps.consequence: No timeouts, retries, cancellation, retry budgets, loop detection, or circuit breaking.
gaps.remediation: Implemented bounded retries, per-task deadlines, cancellation, loop detection and per-adapter circuit breakers.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Timeout, cancellation, retry exhaustion, loop detection and open-circuit tests produce explicit terminal outcomes.

gaps.consequence: Agent/adapter output was untrusted and unvalidated.
gaps.remediation: Adapter results are schema-validated and mapped to INVALID_OUTPUT/INVALID_INPUT.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Malformed adapter output fails the task and mission without completion.
gaps.evidence: Malformed adapter output test in orchestrator.test.ts.

gaps.remediation: Added typed task events with mission correlation, per-mission buffers and secret-free payloads.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Task lifecycle events are emitted in order for a real execution.
gaps.evidence: Event-order, secret-exclusion and concurrent-buffer tests in orchestrator.test.ts.

gaps.consequence: Durable audit is opt-in and disabled by default; the hash chain is valid but not durable.
gaps.rootCause: BEHAVIOR_OS_AUDIT_LOG is not configured in this environment.
gaps.remediation: Kept the opt-in sink and documented the requirement; append/restart/tamper paths are covered by tests.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Audit-sink tests pass; the final report states durable status truthfully.
gaps.evidence: packages/core/tests/audit-sink.test.ts; sink remains disabled in this session.

gaps.consequence: Human approval is not proven to reach a UI; escalation approval is host-specific.
gaps.rootCause: No approval transport in the core orchestrator.
gaps.remediation: Escalated orchestrator runs stop as blocked pending a later allowed run; no approval is inferred.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Escalated governance verdict blocks execution with an explicit approval-required outcome.
gaps.evidence: Orchestrator escalation test; host approval UI not available for verification.

gaps.consequence: Async write-through cannot prove durable rollback; no nested savepoints.
gaps.rootCause: The Postgres adapter batches async writes and reports errors at flush.
gaps.remediation: Guarantees remain scoped to synchronous stores; documented.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Postgres tests document flush behavior; no false atomicity claim.

gaps.consequence: Whole-snapshot rollback can erase a concurrent lifecycle transition in the same plugin instance.
gaps.rootCause: No per-mission mutex; storage writes are serialized but state mutation is not.
gaps.remediation: Not addressed in S3; keep the documented limitation.
gaps.acceptanceTest: A concurrent lifecycle failure test would be required before claiming a fix.
gaps.evidence: Documented in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md mission exposure section.

gaps.consequence: Task records are not separately persisted; resumption is caller-supplied and relies on mission evidence.
gaps.rootCause: The task domain is new and the store has no task methods.
gaps.remediation: Resumption skips gates already backed by executed evidence; the plan remains caller-supplied.
gaps.acceptanceTest: Resuming an active mission skips tasks whose required gates already have executed evidence.
gaps.evidence: Resume test in orchestrator.test.ts; limitation documented in ARCHITECTURE.md.

gaps.consequence: The long-lived plugin could be stale relative to the built source.
gaps.rootCause: The host loaded an older build; no explicit hot reload.
gaps.remediation: Rebuilt the plugin and core packages; the host then observed the new governance helper.
gaps.acceptanceTest: A call blocked by the old rule succeeds after the rebuild, against the same source.
gaps.evidence: bos_start_mission succeeded in this session; after pnpm build, the previously blocked C4 documentation edit succeeded.

gaps.consequence: The orchestrator is a library only; MCP and plugin do not expose orchestration.
gaps.rootCause: Exposing it requires a new workspace dependency and a dependency install, which governance denied.
gaps.remediation: Deferred; documented as a limitation. No tool count changed (MCP 30 + 2, plugin 32).
gaps.acceptanceTest: A tool-level orchestration test would be required before claiming exposure.
gaps.evidence: pnpm install was denied by license-check before the heuristic was fixed; the mission kept the dependency graph unchanged.

gaps.consequence: No full OBSERVATION→LESSON→CANDIDATE→VALIDATED→POLICY→MONITORED lifecycle; learning records and proposes only.
gaps.rootCause: The learning engine predates the lifecycle requirement.
gaps.remediation: Not implemented in S3; documented as an open gap.
gaps.acceptanceTest: A lifecycle state-machine test with persistence would be required.

gaps.consequence: license-check fired on documentation and read-only text that merely quoted an install command, blocking unrelated edits.
gaps.rootCause: new-dependency was derived from any text without requiring an action able to execute.
gaps.remediation: Derived command signals are dropped for non-executing actions; explicit metadata signals are preserved.
gaps.acceptanceTest: An edit whose context quotes the command is allowed; a real bash command is still flagged.
gaps.evidence: 3 new cases in plugins/opencode-v2/tests/governance.test.ts; the previously blocked C4 edit then succeeded.

gaps.consequence: The real audit security stage fails on 6 advisories: 2 critical (tinypool), 1 high (braces), 3 moderate.
gaps.rootCause: Pre-existing dev-dependency versions (vitest 3.2.7 / tinypool 1.1.1; changesets -> braces 3.0.3).
gaps.remediation: Upgrade lockfile dependencies; requires a network install and a separate change.
gaps.evidence: pnpm audit output recorded in s3-evidence.json; a real audit therefore reports fail.

gaps.consequence: The real audit lint stage only recognises eslint/oxlint, so it reports skipped although Biome is the project linter.
gaps.rootCause: The stage predates the Biome migration.
gaps.remediation: Add Biome detection in a follow-up; Biome is run directly by pnpm lint:check in the ladder.
gaps.acceptanceTest: A real audit reports the lint stage as passed or failed based on Biome.
gaps.evidence: Audit engine source lines 72-87; full audit output in s3-evidence.json.
